description: WRITE: add a comment to a task. `comment_text` is required; the task is the {task_id} path param. ClickUp REST: POST /task/{task_id}/comment.

assignee.description: User id to assign the comment to (numeric).

notify_all.description: If true, notify everyone tagged/subscribed (else just the assignee).

task_id.description: The task id to comment on (path param, not body).

name: clickup_create_task_comment
title: Create task comment
